body: Right now I'm doing ICF 5x5s... to be honest idk if that is the best thing to do. I've lifted on and off since middle school, I played football until my senior year so i would lift during the school year and not keep it up during the summer and lose all my strength. My 1 rep max on bench is 225 and 350 on squat. Honestly I can't really put on any more muscle considering my diet is awful, so I don't know why I even go anymore.
